content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay scales for direct recruitment and deputation basis are structured as follows: Professor: Level-14A (168900-220400) of 7th CPC plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable). Additional Professor: Level-13A2+ (148200–211400) of 7th CPC plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable). Associate Professor: Level-13A1+ (138300–209200) of 7th CPC plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable). Assistant Professor: Level-12 (101500–167400) of 7th CPC plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable). For contractual retired faculty posts, lumpsum remuneration is Rs. 2,20,000/- p.m. for Professor (Consultant) and Rs. 2,00,000/- p.m. for Additional Professor (Consultant). Private practice of any kind, including laboratory and consultant practice, is strictly prohibited.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty (Group-A)
content_sections.text: Fill out the application form in MS Word format as per the provided proforma, take a printout, and sign it along with affixing a photograph. Submit the application through the online Google form link ( Application Form ). Combine all relevant certificates and documents into a single PDF file in the specified order and upload it via the Google form. Remit the application fee online to the specified bank account. Send the duly signed printout of the application form along with Annexure-A, self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents, and fee receipt by Speed/Registered Post to: RECRUITMENT CELL, AIIMS GORAKHPUR, ADMINISTRATIVE BLOCK, KUNRAGHAT, GORAKHPUR – 273008.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Printout of application form and filled Annexure-A Mark sheets and degrees (SSLC to PG, Ph.D. for non-medical posts) Proof of Age Caste Certificate (ST/SC/OBC in prescribed GoI format) / EWS Income and Asset Certificate Experience Certificate(s) No Objection Certificate (NOC) for candidates working in Government organizations Two passport-size photographs Latest original registration certificates (UG & PG) Payment receipt

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the recruitment cell by 14/11/2026. The envelope must be super-scribed with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [Post Name]". Age limits are up to 58 years for Professor/Additional Professor and up to 50 years for Associate Professor/Assistant Professor as on the closing date. OBC candidates must produce NCL-OBC certificates issued between 01.04.2026 and 31.03.2027. Application fee is Rs. 2,000/- for General/OBC/EWS and Rs. 500/- for SC/ST, while PwBD and retired faculty applying on deputation/contract are exempt. Canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification. Interviews will be held in Gorakhpur only, and no TA/DA will be paid.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available in AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 56 vacancies available across various faculty posts and departments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications and sending the hard copy by post is 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for Professor and Additional Professor posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 58 years as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 50 years as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 2,000/- for General, OBC, and EWS category candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee exemption for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee for SC/ST candidates is Rs. 500/-, and it is completely exempted for PwBD candidates and retired faculty applying on deputation or contract basis.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their application online via the designated Google form and also send the printed application copy along with documents via Speed/Registered Post to the AIIMS Gorakhpur address.

faq.question: Q8. Are retired faculty members eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, retired faculty from Institutes of National Importance (INIs) and Government Medical Colleges (GMCs) up to the age of 68 years are eligible to apply on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Is private practice allowed for faculty members?
faq.answer: No, private practice of any kind, including laboratory and consultant practice, is strictly prohibited.
